Please note that passenger rights may be restricted

The prices shown require every passenger to possess a valid Deutschland-Ticket. If the Deutschland-Ticket is applied, the system will calculate a route section price for the ticket that does not include any possible pre-carriage and/or onward carriage in local transport services to/from the long-distance service. For this reason, passenger rights do not apply continuously when transferring between local and long-distance transport. If not every passenger has a Deutschland-Ticket, you must book separate tickets. The transportation of bicycles and dogs is not included in the Deutschland-Ticket. The respective tariff regulations of the nationwide or state tariffs, transport associations and transport companies apply.

Deutschland-Ticket holders can indicate that all passengers have a D-Ticket under \"Passengers, bicycles, BahnCards\". If this option is activated, the system calculates a route section price only for the long-distance part of the journey, which may lead to a cheaper ticket. Passenger rights may be limited. You can also activate the \"D-Ticket connections only\" button to display only connections that can be travelled free of charge with the D-Ticket.
You can view the message again at any time on the start page by clicking \"Edit passengers > Do you have a Deutschland-Ticket?\".

"If the \"Show fastest connections\" search option is activated, we will show you the fastest connection for the selected departure time. This is the connection with which you can arrive as early as possible and depart as late as possible after the selected departure time.
The fastest connections shown after this are displayed based on the departure time of the previous fastest connection, rather than the departure time that you searched for. These are the fastest connections in the subsequent time windows that depart after the previous fastest connection. It is therefore a forward-looking search. The system searches for the next fastest connections in a time window after the originally selected departure time.
In other words: If the search option is activated, you will not be shown alternative connections that also match the departure time you have selected, but are slower than the fastest connection and depart before it. These alternative connections may be faster than the fastest connections displayed afterwards or reach the destination earlier. To see these alternative connections, you must deactivate the \"Show fastest connections\" search option.
In addition to the fastest connections, you may also be shown a connection with fewer transfers and a longer journey time (so-called comfort connection)."

"If the \"Show fastest connections\" search option is activated, we will show you the fastest connection for the selected arrival time. This is the connection with which you can arrive as closely as possible to the selected arrival time and depart as late as possible.
The fastest connections shown before this are displayed based on the arrival time of the next fastest connection, rather than the arrival time that you searched for. These are the fastest connections in the previous time windows that arrive before the next fastest connection. It is therefore a backward-looking search. The system searches for the next fastest connections in a time window before the originally selected arrival time.
This means: If the search option is activated, you will not be shown alternative connections that also match the arrival time you have selected, but are slower than the fastest connection and arrive after it. These alternative connections may be faster than the fastest connections displayed before or reach the destination earlier. To see these alternative connections, you must deactivate the \"Show fastest connections\" search option.
In addition to the fastest connections, you may also be shown a connection with fewer transfers and a longer journey time (so-called comfort connection)."
